name: Lamia
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Finished enemy portrait for the dark fantasy deckbuilder Panlibrarium, matching painterly oil and gouache card paintings. Rich textured brushwork, aged brass, ink, dramatic chiaroscuro, restrained luminous magic, sophisticated fantasy book illustration. Landscape 3:2. ONE dominant subject fills central 70 percent; face in central upper third, important anatomy within frame, large strong silhouette readable at 150 pixels. Background atmospheric and less detailed than subject. No text, no typography, no words, no numbers, no frame, no UI, no watermark. Non-graphic fantasy, no blood or injuries. Human characters adults and fully clothed in armor or layered opaque robes.
Subject: A mythic serpent guardian with an adult woman's head and upper body fully enclosed in bronze armor and opaque layered robes, long turquoise serpent coils below.
World: Mythic ancient Greek world, marble, bronze, laurel, Mediterranean azure and warm white stone; epic classical atmosphere.
Portrait for a selectable enemy in combat. Make silhouette clearly recognizable.
